messages.subject: For Robert Michael | Global biopharma, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Shea,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Robert A. Michael, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

AbbVie's global biopharma platform operates across governments, regulators, health systems and complex stakeholder environments where external alignment matters directly to long-term execution. That interface closely matches my current leadership mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across complex regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, ESG and stakeholder execution might support AbbVie's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to AbbVie.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
